Products

Every piece is made to order. Size, colours and finishing can be chosen to suit your event.

Nettipattam

Gold-beaded frontlets in the style used on festival elephants in Kerala. Made for temple and church festivals, stages, entrances and gifts, with a hand-looped wool border and tassel.

Gift hampers

Boxed gifts with jewellery, chocolates, flowers and keepsakes, arranged for birthdays, festivals and special occasions. Contents can be chosen to suit the person.

Luggage, acrylic trays and gift sets dressed with flowers, tulle and personalised initials for engagements and weddings.

About Thaamrika

Thaamrika is a craft studio based in Malappuram, Kerala. We make traditional decor and gift items by hand, from nettipattam to wedding and festive packing.

Each order is planned with the customer, so the size, colours and details match the occasion.
